# @velosjs/cache

> 标签: cache, caching, esm, modular, plugin, velosjs

## 简介

Efficient and lightweight caching utility for VelosJS — includes in-memory caching, optional persistence, and statistics.

## 官网

- 官网：https://github.com/fajardison/velosjs-cache
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/fajardison/velosjs-cache.git
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@velosjs/cache

- npm 安装：`npm install @velosjs/cache`

- Node 要求：>=22.0.0
